prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a fully designed desktop web application Home screen for Mazi, signed-in shared memory archive for 8 friends. Landscape 1536x1024, straight-on screen capture, no device mockup or presentation annotations. This is an operational memory-browsing interface, never a marketing landing page. Persistent readable navigation: mazi / Home active / Timeline / Search / My Imports / one small group avatar. Synthetic photo content of friends: Mediterranean terrace dinner at dusk, rainy city walks, a lake swim, picnic and birthday table. Selected memory title exactly 'The night we missed the last ferry', metadata 'Summer 2024 · 18 photos · Added by Deniz', visible 'Open memory' action. Small 'Demo memories' label. Design must feel warm and human through large unfiltered full-color photography even where the surrounding system is abstract. No fake metrics, testimonials, public share/publish/privacy controls, likes, AI summaries, notifications, ornamental technology charts, microscopic necessary text, or generic rounded-card dashboard. Every control usable and beautifully spaced. Exceptionally ambitious bespoke studio-quality application design.
STRUCTURE AND WORLD: MEMORY SIGNAL. A continuous architectural time-field of vertical photo fins across middle 65% of screen. A low black stable header above, monospace captions aligned to each dated column. Mostly black/ivory chrome, photography keeps real color. The fins are thin three-dimensional upright photo planes, arranged parallel in shallow perspective like a tactile photographic archive. One selected fin unfolds into a LARGE nearly front-facing color photograph occupying center-right 55% width; adjacent fins compressed but clearly photos, NOT an audio equalizer or data chart. Date index along base of stage: 2022 / 2023 / 2024 / 2025, selected 2024 lightly outlined. Left narrow area a clear large but readable title 'a moment, again.' with selected memory title below, and Open memory as white rectangular control. Small text 'Browse by year'. Selected event also available as ordinary labeled entry in a compact list beneath stage. Hairline rules and mono tabular dates provide precise system. No strobe, no gray techno noise, no waveforms, no invented data. Amber warmth comes ONLY from photos. The experience is picking a moment out of a tangible time-field. Distinct from a 3-photo carousel or photo-stack hero.
